name: CoSQL
description: We present CoSQL, a corpus for building cross-domain, general-purpose database (DB) querying dialogue systems. It consists of 30k+ turns plus 10k+ annotated SQL queries, obtained from a Wizard-of-Oz (WOZ) collection of 3k dialogues querying 200 complex DBs spanning 138 domains. Each dialogue simulates a real-world DB query scenario with a crowd worker as a user exploring the DB and a SQL expert retrieving answers with SQL, clarifying ambiguous questions, or otherwise informing of unanswerable questions.
reputation: A well-known benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL and database dialogue systems, commonly used alongside Spider for cross-domain semantic parsing.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark with complex multi-turn interactions; evaluation often includes SQL exact match and dialogue-level interaction metrics, and scores are substantially lower than simpler text-to-SQL tasks.
